primary_root_cause: Artifact persist boundary had insufficient bounded progress instrumentation and manifest payload ref separation for large semantic payloads.
supporting_evidence: ReadonlyAnalysisArtifactRuntimeService._create_artifact placed declared_contract, schema_coverage, metadata_coverage and inventory_sufficiency summaries into ArtifactRuntimeCreateRequest metadata/provenance.
ArtifactRuntimeService.create forwarded the full request into UniversalArtifactRegistryService.create.

UniversalArtifactRegistryService.create converted content to bytes, built ArtifactRecord with full metadata/provenance, wrote artifact content directly to the final file, then serialized sharded manifest/index.
R2.14 public metrics showed about 17.2 MB materialized and zero payload refs before the persist frontier.
No checkpoints existed inside payload classification, serialization, payload-ref decision, content write, manifest build, manifest persist, registry index update or commit.
disconfirming_evidence: The 17.2 MB value alone does not prove payload refs are required.
R2.14 proved compile/fact/source binding completed; the new frontier is after those boundaries.

payload_ref_findings.reason: Large semantic manifest subtrees can be referenced while the artifact content remains material and downloadable. This keeps manifest/index bounded without making payload_ref a success condition.

patch_plan: Add generic artifact persist progress callbacks through ArtifactRuntimeService and UniversalArtifactRegistryService.

Emit bounded persist checkpoints for materialization, serialization, payload ref decision, payload ref persist, artifact content write, manifest build, manifest persist, registry index update and commit.
Persist artifact content with temp + atomic replace instead of direct final write.
Spill oversized manifest metadata/provenance children to artifact payload refs using a generic configurable inline budget, not a fixture threshold.
Keep payload refs deterministic with byte size and sha256.
Do not mark artifact created before manifest/index commit completes.
Preserve bounded source/fact metrics in endpoint-safe projection.
secondary_contributing_causes: post-commit checkpoint could retroactively convert completed artifact persist into generic render timeout
report collector mixed persist stages across artifacts and used sparse latest-checkpoint metrics
